initial_scene: A pink peach-shaped object rests alone on the black upper shelf at the robot's right. The robot's left hand is already at the rim of a brown paper bag on the table; its right hand is empty beside the lower fruit tray. The camera looks forward and downward between the two near-side arms. People in the background do not handle the robot's task objects.

observed_sequence.action: The left hand holds the brown bag's upper edge while the right hand remains empty near the fruit tray below the shelf.
The right arm raises its open hand toward the pink peach on the upper black shelf. The left hand maintains its bag-rim hold.
The right fingers close around the peach and settle the grasp while the peach remains near shelf level; the left hand continues holding the bag open.
The right hand lifts the peach clear of the shelf and transports it inward toward the bag. The left hand raises the bag rim to present the opening.

The right hand lowers the held peach through the bag opening while the left hand supports the upper rim. A small pink portion is still visible below the left forearm as the right hand descends inside.

The peach becomes occluded within the bag. The right hand remains at the opening beneath the left wrist and makes a small adjustment; no clear empty-hand withdrawal or independent peach support is visible.
